h1: Shopify app maintenance, a starter care sprint
overview: Shopify releases a new API version every quarter and retires old ones, which can quietly break apps. In this one-time sprint we bring your dependencies and API version up to date, fix open bugs, check that webhooks and billing still work and send a short health report. Ongoing monthly maintenance is a separate quote if you want us to keep watching your app.

faq: Is this a monthly maintenance plan?
No. It is a fixed starter sprint with a clear start and end. If you want regular care afterwards, we quote a monthly plan separately, based on what the health report finds.
How do I know my API version is still safe?
Shopify supports each version for about a year. We check which version your calls use, update to a supported one and list any deprecation warnings that will matter in the next release.
Can you fix an app that stopped working after a Shopify change?
Usually yes. Send the error message or a description of what changed, and we confirm the fit before you order. Many such failures come from one removed endpoint or scope.
Do you need access to my servers?
Only to read logs and deploy the update. Add us as a collaborator on your repository and hosting account with limited roles. We never ask for your passwords.
